world:
Create ONE original Hollowtide WORLD ASSET candidate from Asset Brief and linked images. Interpret MODE explicitly. Default MODE PROP. Do not generate a game, mockup, map screenshot or character.
REFERENCE ROLES: Style Anchor governs crisp outlines, pixel clusters and material shading ONLY. If it is a creature, do not transfer creature anatomy, fire motifs or its whole palette. World Perspective Reference governs the top-down three-quarter camera, roof/front-wall depth and scale ONLY; never copy another game's assets, symbols or map. Use modest visible top surfaces and clear front faces, consistent with a 36-logical-pixel adult courier.
MODE PROP: one complete requested object on a 128x128 logical-pixel canvas by default. Asset Brief states footprint in the current 16x16 world tiles. Keep at least 6 logical pixels of clean margin around the entire prop, including leaves, roots and roof tips. Flat #FF00FF outside. No cast shadow on the background; separate shadows can be prepared later.
MODE TILESET: default native tile 16x16, exactly sixteen equal cells in a 4x4 atlas (64x64 logical pixels total), no gutters or margin between cells. Brief names both surface and neighboring material. Row-major cell order: center A, center B, center C, north edge / east edge, south edge, west edge, northwest outer corner / northeast outer, southeast outer, southwest outer, northwest inner corner / northeast inner, southeast inner, southwest inner, repeat center A. Fill every tile to its edges; no magenta unless brief explicitly requests a transparent overlay. Seamless edges with stated neighbor. No dark outline boxing each terrain tile. A 32x32 native tile is allowed ONLY when brief explicitly requests a future grid migration; do not change the current 16x16 game grid automatically.
MODE WATER: four chronological looping surface tiles in 2x2, default16x16 cells, border continuity and shared surface phase. No background gutters; no whitewater unless requested.
MODE PROP SET: only the explicitly named small set in stated equal-size cells. Shared scale, projection and finish; no extra props.
WORLD: mature grounded river frontier folklore. Loess and silt banks, cottonwood and oak, weathered timber, rust-red brick, muted blue-green water, practical courier infrastructure when requested. Original Hollowtide architecture; no borrowed game signs or recognizable characters. Local material ramps, restrained cool shadows, warm upper-left daylight. Quiet ground contrast leaves room for creatures and people. Paths and interactables remain readable. Turbo Green is a selective UI accent, not the global world palette.
FINISH: Cinderhide-quality crisp dark silhouettes on props, selective internal lines, large readable pixel clusters and 4-6 tones per material. Ground tiles use softer contrast without outlines around every cell. Neither sparse old handheld graphics nor painterly detail/noise. No smooth gradients, antialiasing, blur, dithering, random checkerboard grass, repeated stamped tufts, decorative text or frame labels. Use one coherent logical pixel scale; enlarged display may repeat square pixels.
DELIVERY: only the requested image. This is a candidate, not a guaranteed native-size export, transparent PNG, working TileSet, rig or automatic Godot import. Preserve original result for approval and later engine preparation.
worldOutput: Display the original linked generated_pixel_art prominently in a simple Hollowtide World Asset Forge review page. Use the actual image URL unchanged, CSS image-rendering: pixelated, contain fit, no cropping, smoothing, filters, recoloring, added glow or grain over the art. Show Asset Brief and small labeled reference thumbnails below. State Candidate — review before Godot import. Do not claim transparency, exact exported resolution, rigging or engine readiness. Flat magenta can remain visible. Read MODE in Asset Brief: PROP/PROP SET have margins; TILESET/WATER have edge-to-edge cells and no gutters. For TILESET show only the intended row-major legend from the brief/production prompt, clearly as intended rather than verified automatic extraction; no new generated images. Offer an Open original link using the real generated image URL. Only offer a download link if it points to that actual original image; no invented buttons, links or file types. Keep UI quiet and readable; no scans, image hover glows or technical decorations.
character:
Create one Hollowtide overworld CHARACTER candidate from Character Brief. Follow these rules and the linked inputs below. MODE NEW makes an original person; MODE REDRAW preserves the supplied exact character identity. OUTPUT SINGLE gives one full-body neutral standing pose in DIRECTION (default DOWN). OUTPUT TURNAROUND gives four standing views in one 2x2 sheet ordered DOWN, UP / LEFT, RIGHT. Do not generate walking frames.

REFERENCE ROLES: Identity Reference is optional for NEW; NONE means no prior identity. For REDRAW it governs face, hair, clothing, equipment, silhouette and side-specific details. Style Reference governs pixel finish and projection only. A creature anchor must never transfer animal anatomy, armor or Ember colors to the person. A world screenshot is composition/projection reference, never art to copy.

SCALE: default64x64 logical cells and36logical pixels visible standing height, matching the current courier at gameplay scale. For TURNAROUND hold exactly the same height, head size, foot baseline and shared cell origin across all views. Side views must not grow. Adult anatomy, approximately5.5-6head heights, capable grounded posture and readable face; no oversized child head or chibi. Use consistent top-down three-quarter overworld projection with modest head/shoulder tops visible, not an isometric diamond or a flat battle portrait. Both feet naturally planted, arms relaxed, hands clear of torso, no lifted knee. Keep outfit and satchel on their real anatomical side, do not mirror asymmetric designs.

FINISH: original inland river folklore RPG, practical courier/work clothes; Cinderhide-quality crisp dark silhouette outline, selective interior outlines, grouped planes, deliberate clustered shading, compact local palette about20-36colors, warm upper-left daylight and restrained cool shadows. Use individual material ramps, not one global palette or all Turbo Green. Never render smooth painted/vector shading, blur, noisy dithering or mixed pixel sizes.

BACKGROUND: pure flat #FF00FF everywhere outside the person; opaque pixels and stepped color clusters only. Keep entire hair, hands, bag and boots at least6logical pixels from cell edges. No floor shadow, scenery, UI, lettering, frame labels or second character in a cell. Check identity, directional costume consistency, even height/baseline and readable joints before returning ONE image. Logical size is a drawing target; do not claim exported pixels, transparent PNG, rig layers or automatic Godot import.
